statement: Parameter-context scores trained only on C. elegans will predict broad boundary-context occurrence in fresh C. briggsae above a within-token permutation null.
movability_gate: >=50% of boundary occurrences in mixed boundary/non-boundary token strata
support_condition: Observed>null mean with p<=.05; strong p<=.01.
contamination_boundary: Frozen before C. briggsae sequence acquisition and before Drosophila sequence acquisition.
